_説明: 警告 W1 の表(GR19 指示書 3.1 節、設計書 9.2 節)。node tools/model/extract_w1.mjs で out/text/sysml20.txt(SysML 2.0)の 7 章から抜き出した(手で編集しない)。entries は「… usage must (may) only be defined by …」の形の記述で、usage は使用の種類(メタクラス)、allowed は許される定義の種類(メタクラス。下位の種類を含む)、section・line は本文の節と行。excluded は表に入れなかった記述と理由。

entries.sentence: An attribute usage may only be defined by attribute definitions or KerML data types.
An occurrence usage may only be defined by occurrence definitions (of any kind) or KerML classes (see [KerML, 7.4.3]).
An item usage must only be defined by item definitions (of any kind) or KerML structures (see [KerML, 7.4.4]).
a part usage must only be defined by item definitions (including part definitions) or KerML structures (see [KerML, 7.4.4]).
A port usage must only be defined by port definitions.
A connection usage must only be defined by connection definitions (of any kind) or KerML association structures (see [KerML, 7.4.5]).
An interface usage must only be defined by interface definitions.
An allocation usage must only be defined by allocation definitions.
A flow usage must only be defined by flow definitions or KerML interactions (see [KerML, 7.4.10]).
An action usage must only be defined by action definitions (of any kind) or KerML behaviors (see [KerML, 7.4.7]).

entries.ownerText: A requirement definition or usage may also have one or more actor or stakeholder parameters
entries.sentence: Actor and stakeholder parameters are part usages, so they must be (explicitly or implicitly) defined by part definitions (see 7.11.2).

entries.ownerText: A case definition or usage may also have one or more actor parameters
entries.sentence: Actor parameters are part usages, so they must be (explicitly or implicitly) defined by part definitions (see 7.11.2).

excluded.sentence: A usage must always be defined by at least one definition element that corresponds to its usage kind.
